items.title: Megadeals Lift August CRE Sales Volume to $107B
items.summary: CRE sales volume reached $107B in August, but $70B of M&A activity masked a 21% decline in transactions excluding megadeals.

items.title: Active ETFs Are Winning Advisers. Mutual Funds Could Lose Out.
items.summary: Seven in 10 advisers expect to increase their use of active ETFs. Existing mutual fund holdings could provide much of that allocation, sharpening competition around value, differentiation and portfolio fit.

items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: A company that generates cash isn’t automatically a winner. Some businesses stockpile cash but fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their ability to expand.

items.title: Is MSCI Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Though MSCI has lagged behind the broader Nasdaq Composite over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain strongly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Garden Apartment Pricing Reflects Rising Supply Risk
items.summary: Garden apartment pricing is reflecting higher supply risk as cap-rate pressure grows and July transaction volume remains soft.

items.title: Rising Bond Yields Threaten Commercial Real Estate Recovery
items.summary: Rising bond yields threaten the CRE recovery by pressuring property values, liquidity, and institutional investment worldwide.
